_comment: Few-shot exemplars for the Study 2 'examples' factor. Approved by the author on 2026-10-26 without changes. Taken from PURE documents that supply none of the 150 test items (grid bgc, hats, eirene sys 15). Order is fixed: one exemplar per EARS pattern, in the order the patterns are listed in prompts/components/patterns.txt. Do not edit after the freeze commit.

overlap_check.method: max share of shared word 3-grams between each exemplar and each test item (source text and messified text), relative to the shorter text

closest_items.PURE-126: shares generic phrase 'graphical user interface' with the grid bgc exemplar
closest_items.PURE-014: shares 'audible and visual indication' with the eirene sys 15 unwanted-behaviour exemplar

overlap_check.decision: Kept: generic phrasing, not the same requirement. Pre-registered sensitivity analysis excludes PURE-014 and PURE-126 (ANALYSIS_PLAN.md S4).

exemplars.source_text: The system shall provide a graphical user interface to all functions of the system.
exemplars.messified_input: For Grid-BGC, honestly I don't want anyone stuck typing commands. Everything it can do should be reachable through some kind of point-and-click screen, all of it, not just the main bits.
exemplars.ears_output: The Grid-BGC system shall provide a graphical user interface to all of its functions.

exemplars.source_text: [SRSreq 70] When a user selects the File/Save As menu item, the HATS-GUI shall prompt the user to enter a new name.
exemplars.messified_input: In the HATS screen, if somebody hits Save As in the File menu, it should pop up and ask them what they want to call it, you know, a new name.
exemplars.ears_output: WHEN a user selects the File/Save As menu item, the HATS-GUI shall prompt the user to enter a new name.

exemplars.source_text: (M) 5.4.3 If registration is not successful an audible and visual indication shall be provided.
exemplars.messified_input: With the cab radio, if it doesn't manage to get registered on the network, people need to know somehow. A beep and something on the screen, both really.
exemplars.ears_output: IF the Cab radio fails to register with the mobile network, THEN the Cab radio shall provide an audible and a visual indication.

exemplars.source_text: [SRSreq 158] The HATS-GUI shall allow a user to request transformations while HATS-SML is performing transformations or parsing.
exemplars.messified_input: And while the HATS-SML side is busy churning through transformations or parsing stuff, people shouldn't be locked out of the GUI. They should still be able to kick off more transformations.
exemplars.ears_output: WHILE HATS-SML is performing transformations or parsing, the HATS-GUI shall allow the user to request transformations.

exemplars.source_text: 12.2.1 Where text messaging is implemented in the network, the Short Message Service (SMS) shall be used.
exemplars.messified_input: If the network ends up having text messaging at all (it's optional, not every network does), then it should just go over regular SMS, nothing custom.
exemplars.ears_output: WHERE text messaging is implemented in the network, the network shall use the Short Message Service (SMS) for text messages.
